buildArtifactAndDeploymentGovernance.rule: Supported build and package entrypoints fail closed for an unapproved root or source identity. Release packages require clean committed source. Frozen artifact verification binds a reachable source commit, committed versions and complete file hashes. The legacy release wrapper retains exact-ref approval and rollback gates. The separate development guard allows repeated test-only Web and Plugin installations on the registered .125 server after independently protected standing policy provisioning; it requires exact source, artifact, server and path identity, warns about active Beta users, and never authorizes data or production changes. Web publication retires only known obsolete assets before writing index last. Plugin replacement requires a graceful stop and verified relaunch of the pinned development instance. Production .50 remains denied during development testing.
buildArtifactAndDeploymentGovernance.nonGuarantee: Repository scripts do not prevent arbitrary manual filesystem writes or replace independently controlled operating-system permissions. In-place per-file Web publication is rollback-capable but not a single atomic directory switch. Local fixture tests do not prove hosted cache behavior, old-tab convergence, or physical acceptance.

newUserBootstrapAndMigration.authority: Jellyfin creates the user before returning its ID; PTV reservation, ledger, and administrator verification own Home eligibility proof, not account existence
newUserBootstrapAndMigration.sequence: Web saves a server-scoped creation hint at prepared before Plugin reserve, then create-started after confirmed reservation and before stock Create; legacy missing stage cannot prove Create never started. A confirmed unbound reservation may omit nullable userId; Web accepts only omitted/null and still requires matching operation, reserved state, migration hold, and bootstrapRequired=false. Reservation changes refresh recovery and verification siblings. An uncertain reserve retains the local creation/verification hold; an unlisted hint requires exact read-only Plugin operation-status reconciliation. Only prepared plus authoritative absent can release that hint; create-started or legacy-stage absent remains held. Web checks the active administrator, server, and Plugin session before stock Create and between new-user bootstrap mutations; interruption retains the recovery hint and any Plugin hold. After binding, new-account bootstrap writes selected library restrictions before role/enabled policy. Explicit administrator recovery reduces an enabled account's role or disables it first when applicable; otherwise it writes libraries before enablement or elevation. Exact Plugin proof follows. These separate Jellyfin writes are not atomic; default stock access may be broad between Create and the first restrictive write. New user remains unproven after ID binding until intended/restrictive policy write, authoritative readback, current-epoch durable per-user proof, and fresh membership; first-install migration freezes exact existing IDs and proves each individually
newUserBootstrapAndMigration.verificationReplayRule: New migration proofs persist VerificationBatchId. An identical verification reuses the prior durable operation and access epoch without a write only when the persisted batch ID equals the current fixed batch, no creation reservation exists, and exact intended/current policy, current topology epoch, and current accessible-library proof still match. Replacement batch at the same topology, legacy missing batch ID, or changed membership requires fresh proof; an uncertain Web POST requires authoritative status/current readback before another review.
newUserBootstrapAndMigration.failureRule: temporary broad/default Jellyfin access, new ID outside fixed cohort, interrupted batch, pending Plugin reservation or local browser creation hold, or missing/corrupt/stale proof cannot authorize owned Home or PTV Featured rows. An empty Plugin pending list does not alone clear an uncertain browser hint; exact operation status must come from a valid durable ledger and missing/corrupt or recovery-restricted provenance cannot prove absence. A later Check verification is read-only and cannot bootstrap on 404, unproven, pending, or failed status. Preserve administrator recovery and confirmed mutation outcomes across later status-read failures

homeUserAccess.currentPolicyProjection: Authenticated no-store GET current reads the exact selected Jellyfin user. Web normalizes complete nested PascalCase currentAccess, expectedAccess, and intendedAccess policy definitions at its Plugin API boundary, rejects mixed/incomplete definitions, and retains EnableAllFolders plus saved EnabledFolders preferences for exact review and verify intent.
homeUserAccess.verificationRetry: Explicit verify requires same fixed batch/user, no pending creation reservation, exact intended and current Jellyfin policy, current topology epoch, and fresh bounded accessible-library evidence. New proofs persist VerificationBatchId; a repeated request returns the existing policy-attested operation/access epoch without a ledger write only when that prior batch ID equals the current batch and PolicyProven still holds against current policy, topology, and exact library IDs. Replacement or legacy batch identity creates fresh proof. Uncertain Web responses require fresh summary/batch and current-user proof readback before another review; no automatic duplicate POST.
homeUserAccess.creationOperationStatus: Administrator-only, private no-store read of one exact operation from the durable ledger. Version 1 response contains creationOperationId, state reserved/bound/recovered/absent, userId for bound, and markedUserIds for recovered. Read does not mutate state; missing/corrupt ledger or recovery-restricted provenance cannot claim absent. Web displays validated recovered markedUserIds as account-review links, not Home proof.
homeUserAccess.creationRecovery: A server-scoped browser operation is a local hold and recovery hint, not Plugin authority. Prepared is saved before reserve and create-started after confirmed reserve before stock Create; missing legacy stage is unknown. Stock Create follows only a confirmed Plugin reservation. Reservation changes refresh recovery and verification siblings. An empty pending list cannot clear the hint; unlisted operations require exact read-only status reconciliation. Only prepared plus authoritative absent releases the local hint; create-started or legacy-stage absent stays held. Confirmed recover/bind stays confirmed even when the following status GET fails, while binding alone never verifies Home access. A later Check verification reads current Plugin proof only and does not restart bootstrap on 404 or unproven/pending/failed status.

configuredPresentationFreshness.rule: Matching old Settings and Featured responses cannot self-validate CURRENT. Only an explicit protected status request initiated after both inputs, bypassing cached/pre-input in-flight results, can grant point-in-time CURRENT.
